results.title: TSA finds stolen Civil War-era cannonballs in a passenger's suitcase at an Alabama airport
results.description: GULF SHORES, Ala. (AP) — A TSA agent discovered a set of stolen Civil War-era cannonballs in a passenger's suitcase during a routine security screening at an Alabama airport earlier this month, law enforcement officials said.
